contract:
Imports from F1's src/lib/orgs/following.ts: loadViewerFollowedOrgIds, loadViewerFollow, loadFollowerCount, publicFollowerCount, flattenCountEmbed, type OrgFollowState. NAMING (C8): the new org fields are org_follow_state: "following"|"not_following", org_follow_source: FollowSource|null, and follower_count: number|null. Never use follow_state, which already means a person follow (UserCard.tsx:27).

1. src/app/api/orgs/route.ts GET
(a) Filter parsing at :134 becomes `raw === "discover" ? "discover" : raw === "following" ? "following" : "mine"`. Add filter=following to the docblock at :91-125.
(b) filter=mine (:175-231): NO CHANGE, byte-identical response. It feeds the chat rail (campus-home.tsx:465), the post-as-club picker (campus-home.tsx:6997) and phone chats (CampusMobile.tsx:1517).
(c) Discover:
- The Promise.all at :241-257 gains a 4th entry, loadViewerFollowedOrgIds(supabase, user.id) (user client). On error, console.error("[orgs GET discover follows]") and continue with an empty set. That matches the recoverable-mislabel reasoning at :259-264; a wrong button is fixed on tap because POST /follow answers already:true.
- The service select at :350-352 appends `, followers:org_followers(count)`. This is one count embed on the existing service query (C11), not per-club head counts and not row reads. If the embed errors, the whole query fails into the existing 500 load_failed at :365-368, never a silent 0.
- In the row mapping (:391-446), destructure `followers` out alongside `members` (:392) and add org_follow_state: followed.has(o.id) ? "following" : "not_following" and follower_count: publicFollowerCount(flattenCountEmbed(followers), role). Owner and admin of that club see the raw number; everyone else sees null below 5.
- C27: member_count becomes `members?.[0]?.count ?? null` (it was ?? 0 at :426). Deployed readers handle null: campus-home.tsx:8446 and :9102 use ?? 0, CampusMobile.tsx:2489 checks typeof.
- The sort at :461 becomes invited 0, everything else 1. audience_blocked rows are followable now (spec §5.1), so they no longer sink.
- Move the per-row mapping into ONE local function that discover and following both call.
(d) NEW filter=following:
- Runs after the ?campus forbidden check at :168-173, which still applies. It is not campus-scoped. A `me` read error gives 500 load_failed, as :154-156 does.
- const FOLLOWING_FILTER_CAP = 100. ids = loadViewerFollowedOrgIds(supabase, user.id, {limit: FOLLOWING_FILTER_CAP + 1}); if !ok, 500 load_failed "Failed to load orgs". has_more = ids.length > CAP; then slice to CAP. No ids gives 200 with orgs [].
- Do the same membership, request, invite, inviter-name and hidden-user reads as :241-320.
- Service orgs query: the same columns plus the members and followers embeds, .in("id", ids).is("hidden_at", null), and q applied as at :359-363. No campus filter, no INVITE_ONLY_ORGS_IN_DISCOVERY filter, no dormancy filter (the row keeps `dormant`).
- Rows come back in ids order (newest follow first). They include clubs where the viewer is a member; `role` null means followed but not joined.
- Response 200 {ok:true, orgs:[the discover row shape, org_follow_state always "following"], has_more:boolean, viewerCampus, viewerCampusId, viewerSystem, campusScope: ALL_CAMPUSES}.

2. src/app/api/orgs/[slug]/route.ts GET (:210-308)
- The Promise.all at :246-252 becomes [ctx, memberCountRes, loadViewerFollow(service, org.id, user.id), loadFollowerCount(service, org.id)].
- A failed follow read gives 500 load_failed, the same rule as ctx.ok at :253-257. Nothing new is sent before the not_found check at :266-268.
- org gains: org_follow_state (row ? "following" : "not_following"), org_follow_source: row?.source ?? null, and follower_count: publicFollowerCount(raw, ctx.role).
- C27: member_count becomes memberCountRes.error ? null : (memberCountRes.count ?? null) (it was count ?? 0 at :292).
- PATCH and DELETE are untouched.

3. src/app/api/orgs/[slug]/profile/route.ts GET (works signed out)
- The existing hidden gate at :101-106 stays FIRST; every new read runs after it (C12).
- The member count read at :108-111 runs in parallel with loadFollowerCount(service, org.id) and, when signed in, loadViewerFollow(service, org.id, user.id). A failed follow read for a signed-in viewer gives 500 load_failed, shaped like :73-81.
- org literal (:149-168, written out field by field, never spread) gains follower_count: publicFollowerCount(raw, ctx?.role ?? null). Signed-out viewers always get the floored number. C27: member_count becomes error ? null : count ?? null (was ?? 0 at :167).
- viewer (:169-183) gains org_follow_state: user ? (row ? "following" : "not_following") : null (null means signed out, so the client shows Sign in to follow) and org_follow_source: row?.source ?? null.
acceptance: For the same account, the `/api/orgs?filter=mine` JSON before and after the diff is identical (save both and diff them). This protects the chat rail.
Discover rows carry org_follow_state and follower_count. SAE's follower_count is null for a non-officer (1 is below 5) and 1 for SAE's owner. member_count is still a number.

`/api/orgs?filter=following` as SAE's owner returns SAE with role "owner", org_follow_state "following" and has_more false. Hidden followed clubs are absent. `?filter=following&campus=purdue-west-lafayette` as an IU viewer still gives 403 campus_not_in_system.
`/api/orgs/sae` as the owner has org_follow_state "following" and org_follow_source "join"; as a non-member it has "not_following" and org_follow_source null.

Unauthenticated `curl /api/orgs/sae/profile` gives org.follower_count null, viewer.org_follow_state null and viewer.join_state null. Unauthenticated `curl /api/orgs/<hidden test handle>/profile` gives 404 not_found, unchanged.
With loadFollowerCount forced to fail locally (a bad column name on a dev run), follower_count is null, never 0. A forced member-count failure gives member_count null on [slug] and profile.
`npx tsc --noEmit` is clean and the eslint count is not above HEAD's.
